note: The start URL sets countryId=10060012 (Singapore) and offerFlag=1. The server fills the hidden countryId field and returns nine Global featured tiles, the same set seen with Malaysia or Japan country IDs. A GET without a countryId returns a worldwide catalog of 376 offers; that catalog was not used as the Singapore listing. A further country-filtered set would need the on-page Search form POST, which this recipe does not submit. total and merchantPage are both 1 on the saved page, so there is no further GET page.
